_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

rooms.basis: operating rooms in Walter Tower's cardiothoracic suite

cameras_per_room.basis: wall mounted cameras in each operating room, the quote's 'four'

deploy_year.basis: year the software was deployed at Walter Tower, December

window_cases.basis: surgical cases at the suite over the window

added_cases.basis: estimated additional cases a month, approximately

ci_low.basis: lower end of the 95 percent interval, cases a month

ci_high.basis: upper end of the 95 percent interval, cases a month

rise_pct.basis: percent increase in monthly case volume relative to baseline

perm_units.basis: units in the placebo permutation test, Walter Tower and its donor sites

donor_sites.basis: donor sites in the permutation test

perm_p.basis: empirical p of the permutation test

perm_rank.basis: Walter Tower's rank among the units, the quote's 'second'

video_days.basis: days video is retained at most, per the paper

audio_days.basis: days audio is retained at most, per the paper

access_roles.basis: roles that may open an intraoperative recording, the quote's 'three'

train_cases.basis: surgical cases in the training data

train_rooms.basis: operating rooms in the training data

published_day.basis: day of June 2026 the study was published

post_end_year.basis: year the post deployment period ended, September

cameras_total.basis: cameras across the suite, 15 rooms times 4

with_added.basis: baseline plus the estimate, approximately; drawn, never printed

ci_low_whole.basis: the interval's low end floored to a whole case for drawing, 8.3 to 8

ci_high_whole.basis: the interval's high end floored to a whole case for drawing, 41.0 to 41

years_to_publish.basis: years from the end of the study window, September 2023, to publication in June 2026
